name: Troll Mode
description: Adds random, harmless chaos to your Geometry Dash sessions: screen wobble, fake death messages, randomized percentage text, surprise jump inversions and troll popups. Fully configurable, everything can be turned off in the mod settings.

enabled.name: Enable Troll Mode
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn this off to disable every troll effect instantly.

troll-chance.name: Troll Chance (%)
troll-chance.description: How likely each troll event is to trigger. Higher = more chaos.

screen-wobble.name: Screen Wobble
screen-wobble.description: Randomly nudges/rotates the camera slightly while playing a level.

fake-percentage.name: Fake Percentage Troll
fake-percentage.description: Occasionally flashes a fake (wrong) percentage number for a split second.

troll-death-messages.name: Troll Death Popups
troll-death-messages.description: Shows a random silly message in a popup after you die.

jump-inversion.name: Surprise Jump Inversion
jump-inversion.description: Very rarely inverts your jump input for a single tap. Can make levels harder!
